blocks.task_summary: Decompose f'(x) = 1/(x(k-x)) into partial fractions a/x + b/(k-x) and find a, b in terms of k.
method_path: Multiply through by x(k-x) to obtain 1 = a(k-x) + bx
Compare coefficients or substitute x=0, x=k to solve for a=1/k, b=1/k
accepted_alternatives: substitute x=k and x=0 to obtain equations and solve

evidence.basis: Markscheme shows (A1) for partial fraction setup, (M1) for attempt to compare coefficients OR substitute x=k and x=0 and solve, A1 for a=1/k and b=1/k.

blocks.task_summary: Integrate f'(x) = 1/(kx) + 1/(k(k-x)) to find f(x) = (1/k)ln|x/(k-x)| + c.

evidence.basis: Markscheme: (M1) attempt to integrate their f', A1A1 for f(x) = (1/k)(ln x - ln(k-x)) + c = (1/k)ln(x/(k-x)) + c. Note: Award A1 for each correct term. Condone absence of +c.

blocks.task_summary: Solve the logistic differential equation dP/dt = P(k-P)/(5k) with P(0)=1200, showing P = 1200k/(1200+(k-1200)e^(-t/5)).
method_path: Substitute t=0, P=1200 to find c = 5ln(1200/(k-1200))
Rearrange to isolate P and obtain P = 1200k/(1200+(k-1200)e^(-t/5))
accepted_alternatives: Alternative route: ln(P/(k-P)) = t/5 + c, then P/(k-P) = Ae^(t/5), substitute t=0, P=1200 to find A=1200/(k-1200), then rearrange to final form.

evidence.basis: Markscheme: M1 separate variables and integrate. A1 for 5(ln P - ln(k-P)) = t + c. EITHER branch: M1 substitute t=0, P=1200, A1 c = 5ln(1200/(k-1200)), further A1, A1. OR branch: ln(P/(k-P)) = t/5 + c, A1 P/(k-P) = Ae^(t/5), M1 substitute initial conditions, A1, A1. THEN M1 rearrange to isolate P, A1 final answer (AG).

blocks.task_summary: Given population doubles by t=10 (P=2400), find k correct to four significant figures.

evidence.basis: Markscheme: (M1) attempt to substitute t=10, P=2400. (A1) for correct equation. A1 for k=2845 (4 s.f.). Note: Award (M1)(A1)A0 for any other value of k which rounds to 2850.

blocks.task_summary: Find t when the rate of change of the population dP/dt is at its maximum.
method_path: Recognise dP/dt = P(k-P)/(5k) is maximised when P(k-P) is minimised, at P = k/2
accepted_alternatives: Find maximum of the graph of dP/dt
Find zero of the second derivative graph of P

evidence.basis: Markscheme: (M1) attempt to find maximum of first derivative graph OR zero of second derivative graph OR that P = k/2. A2 for t = 1.58 days (accept any value rounding to 1.6).
